name: Chidori
source: Chidori is a servant who works for the Kichiji clan, and is a leader of great talent. He is also the cousin of Yae and Hakuen. A serious, cool, polite person who doesn't show much emotion. He is the type to say "I'm surprised", with the same facial expression as usual.
